You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
i=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
diff=[(r,c,i[r][c],o[r][c]) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if i[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
print(diff)

def solve(g):

    # find marker diagonals of a non-background color; assume marker cells form a short diagonal;
    # determine step by sorting; walk from extreme cell; bounce off grid borders; mark new cells with 3
    import collections
    vals=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=max(((v,k) for v,k in vals.items()),key=lambda x:x[1])[0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (bg,) and g[r][c]!=3]
    m=min(vals,key=lambda v:(v!=bg,vals[v]))
    # collect marker cells
    mk=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==m]
    if len(mk)<2: return None
    mk.sort()
    dr=(mk[1][0]-mk[0][0]); dc=(mk[1][1]-mk[0][1])
    s=(dr//abs(dr) if dr else 0,dc//abs(dc) if dc else 0)
    # start walking from last marker cell along step direction
    cur=mk[-1]
    while True:
        nr,nc=cur[0]+s[0],cur[1]+s[1]
        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W:
            if g[nr][nc]==bg:
                g[nr][nc]=3; cur=(nr,nc)
            elif g[nr][nc]==m:
                pass
            else:
                break
        else:
            break
    return g

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=max(set(v for r in g for v in r),key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in g))
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    seed=min((c for c in cnt if c!=bg), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    cells=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==seed)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def ray(start,d):
        path=[]; i,j=start
        while True:
            ni,nj=i+d[0],j+d[1]
            if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): return (path,False,None)
            if g[ni][nj]!=bg: return (path,True,(ni,nj))
            i,j=ni,nj; path.append((i,j))
    cands=[]
    for start,d in ((cells[0],(-1,-1)),(cells[-1],(1,1)),(cells[0],(-1,1)),(cells[-1],(1,-1))):
        p,y,hit=ray(start,d)
        if y and hit is not None:
            cands.append((p,y,d,hit,len(p)))
    assert cands, cands
    p,d,hit,L=max(cands,key=lambda c:c[4])
    ep=p[-1]
    hi,wi=hit
    free=lambda a,b: 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==bg
    norm=((d[0]>0)-(d[0]<0),(d[1]>0)-(d[1]<0))
    valids=[f for f in [(-norm[0],norm[1]),(norm[0],-norm[1])] if free(ep[0]+f[0],ep[1]+f[1])]
    dr,dc=valids[0]
    for i,j in p: out[i][j]=3
    i,j=ep
    while True:
        ni,nj=i+dr,j+dc
        if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): break
        if g[ni][nj]!=bg: break
        i,j=ni,nj; out[i][j]=3

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    tcol=min((c for c in cnt if c!=bg),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==tcol]
    pts.sort()
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def walk(start,d):
        path=[]; pos=start
        while True:
            n=(pos[0]+d[0],pos[1]+d[1])
            if not(0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W): return path,'OUT',None,pos,d
            v=g[n[0]][n[1]]
            if v==tcol: pos=n; continue
            if v!=bg: return path,'BLOCK',v,pos,n,d
            path.append(n); pos=n
    sdir=(pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0],pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1])
    # tail is always a unit-diagonal run? assume so (all demos yes). direction dr,dc from first to last.
    dr=sdir[0]; dc=sdir[1]; L=max(abs(dr),abs(dc))
    dr//=L; dc//=L
    F=walk(pts[-1],(dr,dc)); B=walk(pts[0],(-dr,-dc))
    cands=F+B
    bouncers=[(i,c) for i,(p,o,v,pn,d) in enumerate(cands) if o=='BLOCK']
    if len(bouncers)==1: idx=bouncers[0][0]
    elif len(bouncers)==2: idx=None  # need more info
    else: idx=max(len(cands[0]),len(cands[1])); idx=idx%2
    chosen=cands[idx]
    p,o,v,pn,d=chosen
    seg=p
    res=[]
    for fdr,fcd in [(True,False),(False,True)]:
        nd=(dr*(-fdr),dc*(-fcd))
        m=(pn[0]+nd[0],pn[1]+nd[1])
        if 0<=m[0]<H and 0<=m[1]<W and g[m[0]][m[1]]==bg:
            q=m; dd=nd

                vv=g[n2[0]][n2[1]]
                if vv==tcol: q=n2; continue

                res.append(n2); q=n2
            break

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    tcol=min((c for c in cnt if c!=bg),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==tcol]
    pts.sort()
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def walk(start,d):
        path=[]; pos=start
        while True:
            n=(pos[0]+d[0],pos[1]+d[1])
            if not(0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W): return (path,'OUT',None)
            v=g[n[0]][n[1]]
            if v==tcol: pos=n; continue
            if v!=bg: return (path,'BLOCK',n)
            path.append(n); pos=n
    sdir=(pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0],pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1]); L=max(abs(sdir[0]),abs(sdir[1]))
    dr,dc=sdir[0]//L,sdir[1]//L
    W1,W2=walk(pts[-1],(dr,dc)),walk(pts[0],(-dr,-dc))
    best=None
    for w in [W1,W2]:
        p,o,bn=w
        if o!='BLOCK': continue
        dleg=(dr,dc) if w is W1 else (-dr,-dc)
        # try both flips
        for fdr,fcd in [(True,False),(False,True)]:
            nd=(dleg[0]*(-1 if fdr else 1), dleg[1]*(-1 if fcd else 1))
            m=(bn[0]+nd[0],bn[1]+nd[1])
            if 0<=m[0]<H and 0<=m[1]<W and g[m[0]][m[1]]==bg:
                q=m; dd=nd; segres=[]
                while True:
                    n2=(q[0]+dd[0],q[1]+dd[1])
                    if not(0<=n2[0]<H and 0<=n2[1]<W): break
                    vv=g[n2[0]][n2[1]]
                    if vv==tcol: q=n2; continue
                    if vv!=bg: break
                    segres.append(n2); q=n2
                total=len(p)+len(segres)
                if best is None or total>best[0]:
                    best=(total,p+segres,p,o,bn,dleg)
    total,p,p2,o,bn,dleg=best
    for i,j in p+p2:
        if g[i][j]!=tcol: out[i][j]=3
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    ok=solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']
    print(k,ok)
    if not ok:
        gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']; o=solve(gi)

def analyze(g,go=None,tlabel='demo'):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    tcol=min((c for c in cnt if c!=bg),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==tcol)
    print(tlabel,'shape',H,W,'bg',bg,'tcol',tcol,'pts',pts)
    # tails orientation
    for a,b in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
        di,dj=b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]; print('   step',(di,dj))
    return g,go,H,W,bg,tcol,pts

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    tcol=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    bcol=others[0] if len(others)==2 else None
    pts=sorted([(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==tcol])
    d=(pts[1][0]-pts[0][0],pts[1][1]-pts[0][1]); gg=math.gcd(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1])); d=(d[0]//gg,d[1]//gg)
    v=None; v0=None; Q=None
    for s in (1,-1):
        # walk from appropriate tail end along s*d
        start = pts[-1] if s==1 else pts[0]
        prev=None
        cur=start
        hit=False
        while True:
            nxt=(cur[0]+s*d[0],cur[1]+s*d[1])
            if not(0<=nxt[0]<H and 0<=nxt[1]<W): break
            if g[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bcol: hit=nxt; hit=True; break
            cur=nxt
        if hit:
            v=(s*d[0],s*d[1]); v0=cur; Q=hit; break
    res=set(pts)
    for rn,rc in [(v[0],v[1]),(-v[0],v[1]),(v[0],-v[1])]:
        if (rn,rc)==(-v[0],-v[1]): continue
        cells=[]; cur=(v0[0]+rn,v0[1]+rc)
        while 0<=cur[0]<H and 0<=cur[1]<W:
            if g[cur[0]][cur[1]]==bcol: break
            cells.append(cur)
            cur=(cur[0]+rn,cur[1]+rc)
        if not cells: continue

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnts=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bgc=cnts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    out=[r[:] for r in gi]

    for s in (1,-1):
        cur = pts[-1] if s==1 else pts[0]
        hit=None; ok=False
        while True:

            if not(0<=nxt[0]<H and 0<=nxt[1]<W): break
            if gi[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==bc:

        if ok:

        out[cc[0]][cc[1]]=3; cc=(cc[0]-v[0],cc[1]+v[1])
    return out

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnts=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bgc=cnts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnts if c!=bgc]
    tc=min(others,key=lambda c:cnts[c]); bc=max(set(others)-{tc})
    pts=sorted([(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==tc])
    d=(pts[1][0]-pts[0][0],pts[1][1]-pts[0][1]); gg=math.gcd(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1])); d=(d[0]//gg,d[1]//gg)
    # block bbox aspect
    bb=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==bc]
    bh=max(i for i,_ in bb)-min(i for i,_ in bb)+1
    bw=max(j for _,j in bb)-min(j for _,j in bb)+1
    horiz_band = bh<=bw          # wide band -> flip row component
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    def is_obstacle(r,c):
        return not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W) or gi[r][c] not in (bgc,tc)
    for start,v in [(pts[-1],d),(pts[0],(-d[0],-d[1]))]:
        cur=start; ql=[]
        while True:
            nxt=(cur[0]+v[0],cur[1]+v[1])
            if is_obstacle(*nxt): break
            ql.append(nxt); cur=nxt
        if not ql: continue
        hit=(cur[0]+v[0],cur[1]+v[1])
        for cc in ql: out[cc[0]][cc[1]]=3
        qh,qy=ql[-1]
        ref=(-v[0],v[1]) if horiz_band else (v[0],-v[1])
        cur=(qh+ref[0],qy+ref[1])
        while 0<=cur[0]<H and 0<=cur[1]<W and gi[cur[0]][cur[1]]==bgc:
            out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3; cur=(cur[0]+ref[0],cur[1]+ref[1])
    return out

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnts=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bgc=cnts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnts if c!=bgc]
    tc=min(others,key=lambda c:cnts[c]); bc=[c for c in others if c!=tc][0]
    bb=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==bc]
    bh=max(i for i,_ in bb)-min(i for i,_ in bb)+1; bw=max(j for _,j in bb)-min(j for _,j in bb)+1
    horiz_band=bh<=bw
    pts=sorted([(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==tc])
    d=(pts[1][0]-pts[0][0],pts[1][1]-pts[0][1]); gg=math.gcd(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1])); d=(d[0]//gg,d[1]//gg)
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    def is_block(r,c): return 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and gi[r][c]==bc
    for start,v in [(pts[-1],d),(pts[0],(-d[0],-d[1]))]:
        cur=start; ql=[]
        while True:
            nxt=(cur[0]+v[0],cur[1]+v[1])
            if not(0<=nxt[0]<H and 0<=nxt[1]<W): break
            if is_block(*nxt): break
            ql.append(nxt); cur=nxt
        if not ql: continue
        Q=ql[-1]; hit=(Q[0]+v[0],Q[1]+v[1])
        for cc in ql: out[cc[0]][cc[1]]=3

        cur=(Q[0]+ref[0],Q[1]+ref[1])

            out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3; cur=(cur[0]+ref[0],cur[1]+ref[1])
    return out
